## Where it runs

| Where | Runs |
| --- | --- |
| Data pipeline (run the graph, **Run step**, previews) | No: HuberLoss is a training loss node; PipelineExecutor loss execution is not implemented |
| Training (the compiled model) | Yes, as the loss |

The node runs on the device chosen for the run (CPU or a GPU); a node does not fix a device.
